title: Cerignola si ferma contro il carovita
content:
Continuiamo a raccontare le proteste in corso nel sud Italia, questa volta a partire dall’esperienza di chi si è mobilitato in Puglia, in particolare a Cerignola. Agricoltori, auto trasportatori, lavoratori e studenti si sono uniti nelle piazze e, ci spiega Vincenzo Pinnelli, uno dei portavoce del movimento, continueranno a farlo.


Da Radio Blackout


Non sono ritenute risposte sufficienti le promesse di Salvini di ieri a Milano, al tavolo di negoziazione con gli auto trasportatori. Si aspetta il prossimo incontro e intanto la mobilitazione continua. Anche perché sul piano agricolo, le risposte arrivate finora sono ancora meno.


Proseguono i blocchi degli auto trasportatori in Puglia, Calabria e Campania, e da ieri si estendono al centro Italia, in particolare Lazio e Molise. Le conseguenze materiali si sentono già: supermercati senza prodotti freschi in diverse di queste regioni e più in generale perdite economiche non indifferenti per il sistema. Insomma emerge forte chiaro la voce ma anche il potere di alcune delle categorie che il sistema della GDO prova ad invisibilizzare.

author: CNT Madrid
title: Bajemos los alquileres, subamos los salarios: 11N, huelga general
content:
Llevamos tiempo escuchando con atención, respeto y convicción las luchas que impulsan los colectivos del movimiento por la vivienda: los sindicatos de inquilinas e inquilinos, las PAH, las asambleas de barrio, los grupos contra los desahucios y todos los espacios libertarios y populares que se plantan frente al acoso inmobiliario. Para la CNT, este conflicto no es una causa ajena ni una lucha que contemplemos desde fuera. Quien nos explota durante la jornada laboral pertenece a la misma clase que nos arrebata el techo cuando salimos del trabajo.


El próximo 11 de noviembre vamos a la huelga general. Lo hacemos desde el anarcosindicalismo, con la acción directa como herramienta y la autoorganización como garantía de nuestra fuerza colectiva. No estamos ante un desajuste del mercado ni ante una crisis pasajera: sufrimos una ofensiva patronal y rentista en toda regla. Mientras nos exprimen con salarios de miseria, jornadas interminables y horas extras impagadas, los rentistas y la patronal inmobiliaria devoran una parte cada vez mayor de nuestros ingresos. Nos quieren explotadas en el trabajo y desahuciadas en la calle.


Es hora de señalarlo sin rodeos: patronales y rentistas son enemigos de la clase trabajadora. Son las dos caras de una misma maquinaria de dominación capitalista. Mientras el empresariado abarata el despido, precariza nuestras vidas y ataca nuestras secciones sindicales, bancos, fondos buitre y grandes tenedores acaparan viviendas, disparan los alquileres y expulsan a las familias trabajadoras de sus barrios. Su beneficio es nuestro empobrecimiento; su acumulación, nuestra precariedad. No hay intereses comunes que conciliar entre quienes especulan con nuestras necesidades y quienes tenemos que luchar para satisfacerlas. Hay un conflicto de clase que no podemos ignorar.


Desde la CNT lo decimos claramente: no depositamos nuestra confianza en las leyes ni en los gobiernos, sean del color que sean. La legislación sobre vivienda y las promesas de los despachos parlamentarios no han resuelto el problema de fondo: un sistema que convierte un derecho básico en una fuente de lucro y protege la acumulación especulativa frente a las necesidades de la mayoría. La historia del movimiento obrero nos enseña que los derechos no se conquistan implorando a las instituciones, sino organizándonos desde abajo, mediante la huelga, el boicot, la solidaridad de clase, la acción directa y el apoyo mutuo.


La huelga general del 11 de noviembre debe ser un golpe sobre la mesa frente a la alianza entre la patronal y el rentismo. Exigimos una bajada inmediata y drástica de los alquileres; el cese de todos los desahucios cuando no exista una alternativa habitacional digna; la expropiación social, sin indemnización, de las viviendas acumuladas con fines especulativos por bancos, SOCIMI y fondos buitre; y el fin de la mercantilización de un bien imprescindible para la vida. La vivienda debe estar al servicio de quienes la habitan, no de quienes hacen negocio con nuestra necesidad de tener un techo.


Porque no puede haber justicia social mientras seamos pobres en el trabajo y precarias en nuestros hogares. Porque la lucha por una vivienda digna es también una lucha sindical. Porque frente a quienes pretenden enfrentarnos y aislarnos, tenemos la fuerza de organizarnos, apoyarnos y luchar juntas.


Si la patronal nos aprieta y los rentistas nos asfixian, la respuesta de la clase trabajadora será colectiva y contundente: paramos la producción, paralizamos el consumo y tomamos las calles.


¡El 11 de noviembre, huelga general!


¡Contra la explotación laboral y el rentismo, organización y lucha!


¡La vivienda es un derecho, no un negocio!


¡Unamos las luchas de la clase trabajadora!

author: Unknown
title: HANA: Iranian regime abducts and disappears Kurds
content:
The HANA Human Rights Organization has published a report on the arrest and abduction of Kurds by the Iranian regime.


According to the report, Diyako Bayezîdî and Mustafa Coşkar, both from Mahabad, were detained by the Iranian regime’s intelligence forces in the city and taken to an undisclosed location. The report also stated that 17-year-old Îlya Lutfî Tormakçî, who lives in the city of Baneh, was abducted by masked forces affiliated with the Iranian regime.


The report further noted that 19-year-old Ehed Meyhenxahî, from the Shino district of Urmia, was arrested on 19 October and transferred to Naghadeh Prison following a five-year prison sentence imposed on him.


Ehed Meyhenxahî had previously been detained by Iran’s Ministry of Intelligence (Ettelaat) on 24 January 2026, without a prosecutorial order, and was released on bail approximately one month later. He was subsequently sentenced to prison by the Shino Revolutionary Court on charges of “assisting anti-Iran opposition.”


The Hana Human Rights Organization’s report also stated that on 16 October, intelligence forces of the Iranian regime raided the home of Aram Eminî in Saqqez and abducted him without a written warrant or a prosecutorial order. The report said that, despite five days having passed, no information was yet available regarding Aram Eminî’s whereabouts.

author: Unknown
title: Diyarbakır Bar Association: 568 rights violations against children recorded in six months
content:
The Diyarbakır Bar Association’s Children’s Rights Center compiled reports of children’s rights violations that came to public attention during the first six months of the year. According to the report, a total of 344 children lost their lives during this six-month period. Of these children, 326 died from preventable causes, while 18 died under suspicious circumstances.


A total of 224 children were involved in cases involving sexual offenses, violence, and grievous bodily harm, while the total number of children affected by violations of the right to life and other forms of victimization was recorded at 568.


Recommendations


The report outlined the following structural and legal recommendations:


- School Security, Public Safety in Surrounding Areas, and Disarmament: Physical inspections and X-ray barriers should be installed to prevent weapons such as smooth bore hunting rifles and knives from being brought into educational institutions. Criminal penalties for civilian gun ownership should be increased.


- MESEM Programs Should Be Suspended: MESEM programs, which place children in heavy and hazardous occupations, should be suspended. Industrial facilities and construction sites should be inspected by independent, multi-stakeholder monitoring boards.


- Comprehensive Protection for Children of Seasonal Agricultural Workers: Families’ journeys to and from work locations should be documented. Transportation in unsafe vehicles should be prohibited, and mobile daycare centers should be made compulsory in accommodation areas.


- Early Warning and Psychosocial Support: During examination periods such as the LGS and YKS, school counseling staff should be increased to address academic pressure. “Early Risk Alert Networks” should be established to intervene within 48 hours at the homes of children who are frequently absent from school or reported to be in crisis.


- Urban Design and Waterways Should Meet “Child-Friendly” Standards: The State Hydraulic Works (DSİ), the General Directorate of Highways, and municipalities should be required to enclose irrigation canals, ponds, and stream beds with tall, vertical-panel fences.


- End Impunity in Suspicious Child Deaths: In all cases classified as “suspicious death,” “accidental shooting at home,” or “falling from a balcony,” investigators should thoroughly examine the possibility of hidden domestic abuse, systematic violence, and cyber-blackmail.


568 rights violations


The report continued:


“The data documenting 568 child rights violations during the first six months of 2026 demonstrate that Türkiye’s child protection system remains reactive—initiating legal proceedings only after an incident has occurred—while preventive, risk-anticipating, and protective public policies are not being implemented in a comprehensive manner.


Ensuring the full protection of children’s rights to life, health, and safety requires state institutions, the judiciary, the education and healthcare systems, local authorities, and civil society to urgently implement a child-centered, rights-based, and binding child protection policy.”

author: Unknown
title: Second issue of Academy of Social Science Journal published
content:
The Academy of Social Science is an intellectual and political initiative devoted to the development of an integrative social science—“the sociology of freedom.” Inspired by the ideas of Abdullah Öcalan, the Academy explores human possibility, collective freedom, communality, and, in general, building of democratic modernity beyond domination and exploitation.


The journal of the Academy of Social Science,

Democratic Modernity

, is a project to rethink social science as a means of human emancipation rather than simply an academic field of study. Its motto,

Towards a Sociology of Freedom

, is strongly influenced by all struggles for freedom and equality, including Abdullah Öcalan’s paradigm of Democratic Civilization, the concept of democratic modernity, the revolutionary experience of Rojava, and the Kurdish women’s freedom movement. 


The journal critiques capitalism, hierarchical institutions, and conventional disciplinary boundaries, advocating instead for forms of social organization grounded in communal life, dignity, ecological awareness, and democratic participation.


The journal combines essays on political theory, sociology, art, food systems, jineolojî, knowledge, and community organizing. The journal will also be the address where the fruit of research communes such as

Long Histories of Democratic Civilization

,

Democratic Foodways

,

Peace

 and

Democratic Confederalism

 and others are shared. Contributors include scholars, activists, and political thinkers, culminating in being an interdisciplinary intellectual project: an attempt to develop a “unified social science” that can support collective resistance, alternative forms of governance, and the practical imagination of a freer society.


Our first issue came out with the title of Towards a Sociology of Freedom, our second issue is the Commune. 


The Commune


This issue explores the commune as a living form of freedom, democracy, solidarity, and social transformation.


In the editorial, Nick Mattheou and the Journal’s Editorial Collective introduce the issue’s central questions. Mustafa Karasu, in

“Kurdistan, the Commune and the Shaping of a Democratic Middle East,”

 presents democratic modernity as a hopeful and practical path centered on women’s liberation, grassroots democracy, and communal confederalism.


In

“Peace, the Commune and the State,”

 Mechthild Exo examines how women’s leadership, grassroots democracy, and the collective shaping of freedom can contribute to a lasting and just peace. Mathijs van de Sande and Gaard Kets, in

“The Many Meanings of the Commune,”

 trace the Paris Commune’s varied interpretations and its continuing emancipatory potential.


We are honoured to publish Abdullah Öcalan’s exclusive contribution,

“The Commune: Founding Unit of Democratic Society,”

 alongside the translation of a poem he wrote in 2000. Together, these texts trace a path toward common life founded on freedom.


In

“We All Have a Story to Tell,”

 Shahrzad Arshadi reflects on art’s power to overcome individualism and nurture collective life, drawing on the resilience of Kurdish women and the philosophy of the commune. Bengi Akbulut, in

“The Commune as an Economic Form,”

 explores how communal organization can reunite production and reproduction, meet genuine social needs, and create a non-patriarchal alternative to systemic exploitation.


Targol Mesbah’s

“Kitchen Experiments: An Invitation to a Democratic Foodways Commune”

 follows the journey of rhubarb to reveal the violence of global capitalism and the sustaining power of communal food practices and traditional knowledge. The article concludes with an ancient Kurdish recipe.


In

“Multinaturalist Ecologies and Commons: Between Latin America and the Middle East,”

 Ana Paula Morel connects radical ecological perspectives across regions and offers a vision of reclaiming the commons and creating democratic, living territories beyond the nation-state.


The issue also presents the speech

“Women in the Struggle: Self-Defense, Resistance and Territorial Protection”

 by Munduruku Wakoborun, delivered at the 2013 Network for Alternative Quest in Hamburg. A review of

Kurdish Women’s Stories

 (2021), edited by Houzan Mahmoud, by Pat Huff and Salima Tasdemir, completes the issue.


The cover and interior artwork by Mona Caron deepen these reflections, connecting the legacy of all these struggles and articles, together with an article on her piece. 


All of these articles …

author: Unknown
title: Philosopher Berardi: Abdullah Öcalan is a beacon of hope in the darkness of our time
content:
Support for the Peace and Democratic Society Process continues to grow among internationally renowned intellectuals, writers, and thinkers. Franco Berardi "Bifo", one of the leading figures of the Italian left, sent a letter entitled “You Are a Beacon of Hope in the Darkness of Our Time” to Leader Apo through the Imrali Delegation.


Addressing Öcalan as “Dear Apo,” Berardi wrote that expectations for the future in Italy and throughout the Western world were bleak, and that the traditional strategies of the left had proved insufficient to halt the worldwide rise of hatred and aggression.


The letter reads as follows:


“Dear Apo,


I have tried many times to find the right words, but this is not easy at all. In my youth, I served short prison sentences; for this reason, I know that such messages can often sound rhetorical and hollow.


As you know very well, expectations for the future are bleak in Italy and throughout the West. The old strategies of the left are proving insufficient to stop the wave of hatred and aggression that is rising everywhere as a consequence of the defeat suffered by the working class worldwide.


Throughout your long years of imprisonment, you have had the courage to rethink the struggle strategy of the democratic Kurdish movement. Moving away from identity-based and nationalist politics marks an important turning point in the history of liberation movements.


During the years you have spent in isolation, you have succeeded in developing a strategy of struggle suited to the twenty-first century. This is why people around the world who value freedom and justice regard you as a point of reference and a guide. In the darkness of our time, your experiences remain one of the few beacons of light that allow us to look to the future with hope.”


Franco Berardi "Bifo"


Born in 1949, Italian philosopher, media theorist, and political thinker Franco Berardi "Bifo" is known for his association with the tradition of autonomist Marxism and his critiques of digital capitalism. Active in Italy’s radical left movements during the 1970s, Berardi is particularly well known for his work on transformations in labor, communication technologies, social alienation, and the psychological effects of capitalism.

title: Viminale identifica i camnionisti per rimuovere i presidi. “Non ci fermiamo”, i blocchi a sud continuano
content:
Contro il caro-carburanti

 Scaffali vuoti in Calabria, Basilicata, Campania (bloccata la A1) e in alcuni casi anche in Puglia e Sicilia; in queste 2 ultime Regioni solo alcune sigle sindacali hanno ritirato i blocchi mentre il governo, per bocca del ministro Urso, ha iniziato a identificare i camionisti “per rimuovere tutti i presidi nelle prossime ore”. I primi numeri del Viminale parlano di 1.339 identificati, 71 denunciati, 242 sanzionati sul piano amministrativo, oltre a disporre scorte di polizia per i tir non in blocco.


Da Radio Onda d’Urto


Per ora la situazione più estesa, a livello di mobilitazione resta quella in

Calabria

, dove sono fermi anche 870 panificatori, mentre gli aeroporti di Crotone e Reggio Calabria sono senza carburante; l’Enav avverte gli aerei in transito da Crotone e Reggio Calabria di “pianificare il rifornimento in precedenza e in quantità sufficiente per le tratte successive”. Le proteste, comunque, continuano e si aggiunge nelle ultime ore anche la mobilitazione dei pescatori.


Una panoramica su quanto sta accadendo in Calabria con Peppe Marra, compagno di Reggio e direnge di Usb Calabria che sta seguendo le mobilitazioni.


Non ha per ora quindi sortito troppi effetti quindi l’incontro di alcune sigle sindacali con Salvini, che ha annunciato lo stanziamento di 480 milioni agli autotrasportatori (soldi già stanziati in estate ma mai sbloccati) per far fronte al caro-carburante per il periodo da marzo a ottobre.


“Sono arrivate 32mila domande e da oggi cominciano i pagamenti”, dice il leghista; a fargli da sponda c’è Coldiretti, da anni braccio agricolo della destra di governo, che ha annullato la manifestazione con i trattori fissata per domani a Napoli dopo la mancia di Salvini. Sempre a Napoli, però, da domani l’intera Università L’Orientale – il più grande ateneo del CentroSud – entra in didattica a distanza, a causa dei blocchi e della mancanza di carburante per raggiungere le aule.


Da Napoli Raul del Si Cobas, lavoratore di un’azienda di logistica

author: CNT Ponent
title: Vivir nos cuesta la vida
content:
Leer en

Castellano

Català


Castellano

Vivir nos cuesta la vida


Llevamos años viviendo una ofensiva sostenida contra las condiciones de vida de la clase trabajadora. Trabajar ya no garantiza vivir con dignidad, cobrar un salario no asegura acceder a una vivienda digna. La productividad mejora pero la jornada laboral se mantiene. Los beneficios empresariales baten récords, pero los salarios quedan estancados. El PIB sube, pero la precariedad se extiende.

La vivienda se ha convertido en un bien inaccesible para muchos de nosotros: hoy, el coste medio para acceder a un hogar supera el 50% de sus ingresos. Mientras los grandes especuladores concentran cada vez más propiedades, las trabajadoras somos condenadas a unos alquileres impagables, vivir endeudados, sufrir pisos en mal estado o no poder independizarnos.


Esta ofensiva no se detiene en la vivienda y los salarios, también se extiende sobre los servicios públicos que sostienen la vida cotidiana. El sistema sanitario y la educación pública sufren un proceso de desmantelamiento progresivo: infrafinanciación crónica, precarización de las plantillas y procesos crecientes de externalización, mientras el negocio privado gana terreno. Mientras, el dinero público se dedica al aumento del gasto militar para librar guerras que hacen subir aún más los precios.

Nos dicen que ésta es la legislatura de la vivienda, o que la economía va mejor que nunca. Pero, en la realidad, los trabajadores no hemos notado nada de esto y seguimos sufriendo para vivir dignamente.

Pero en los últimos meses hemos vivido también cosas esperanzadoras. La comunidad educativa ha hecho huelgas históricas. El campesinado ha conseguido paralizar autopistas y puertos por decir lo suficiente. Y las manifestaciones por la vivienda han logrado obligar a los gobiernos a hacer leyes que no querían hacer. Estos meses hemos visto cómo sólo luchando podemos conseguir mejorar nuestras vidas. Ahora es hora de redoblar la lucha.


Por eso exigimos:


Bajada de los precios de alquiler

El precio del alquiler no puede fijarlo el mercado. Por eso es necesario reformar el índice de referencia de los precios del alquiler y vincularlo a los salarios.


Prohibición de desahucios sin alternativa y contratos indefinidos

Es necesario garantizar las condiciones mínimas de estabilidad residencial como condición para tener una seguridad material. Por eso reclamamos la prohibición de todos los desahucios en casos de personas vulnerables y sin alternativa residencial y que los contratos de alquiler sean indefinidos.


Expropiación de viviendas de bancos y fondos voluntarios

Es necesario recuperar las viviendas de los grandes especuladores y ponerlas bajo control público, así como prohibir las compras especulativas para evitar su acaparamiento.


Construcción de un parque público de vivienda

Es necesario construir un verdadero parque público de vivienda, financiado mediante un impuesto especial al rendismo. También hay que asegurar que sea totalmente público, eliminando los topes de ingresos mínimo para acceder.


Reconocimiento de los derechos sindicales

Los derechos deben garantizarse a través de la autoorganización de los trabajadores. Por eso es necesario reconocer los derechos sindicales en materia de vivienda, incluyendo el derecho a la negociación colectiva, a la representación sindical ya la huelga de alquileres cuando se conviertan en situaciones de incumplimiento por parte de la propiedad.


Aumento del Salario Mínimo Interprofesional (SMI) hasta los 1.600€ y Pensión mínima igual al SMI.

El salario mínimo debe garantizar condiciones de vida dignas. Hoy no lo hace.


Reducción de la jornada laboral a 35 horas semanales que los convenios siempre podrán pactar su reducción.

Reducir la jornada significa repartir el trabajo y combatir el paro, mejorar la salud, la calidad de vida y la conciliación.


Incremento de los salarios con la pérdida efectiva de poder adquisitivo.

Por parte muy importante de la población trabajadora, el alquiler o hipoteca absorben entre el 40% y el 60% de los ingresos, pero su ponderación en el IPC es insuficiente, generando una distorsión entre inflación oficial y coste real de la vida.


Defensa de todos los servicios públicos.


Ni salarios por tierra ni vivienda por las nubes.

author: Unknown
title: Seydayê Cegerxwîn 42 sal berê koça dawî kir
content:
Bi ser koça dawî ya helbestvan û nivîskarê kurd seydayê Cegerxwîn re 42 sal derbas bûn. Cegerxwîn, di sala 1903an de li bajarokê Hesarê yê girêdayî navçeya Kercewsa (ku niha girêdayî Êlihê ye) Mêrdînê ji dayik bû. 


Bi destpêkirina Şerê Yekemîn ê Cîhanê re tevî malbata xwe di sala 1914an de koçî bajarê Amûdê yê Rojavayê kir.  


Cegerxwîn, li vir li ber destê hinek pêşengên olê yên kurd hate perwerdekirin û di sala 1928’yan de dest bi nivîsandina helbestên kurdî kir. Cegerxwîn, Celadet Elî Bedirxan û rêhevalên xwe di sala 1932’yan de li paytexta Sûriyeyê Şamê dest bi weşandina kovara Hawarê kirin û navê Cegerxwîn cara ewil li wir hate bikaranîn. Cegerxwîn, sedema vê jî wiha rave dike: “Ez jî mîna gelê xwe birîndar im. Dilê min birîndar e. Ji cegera min min xwîn tê. Lewma min navê xwe kir kesê cegera wî xwîn jê tê anku Cegerxwîn.” 


Xoybûn


 Cegerxwîn, di nava rêxistina Xoybûnê de jî cih girt ku di Serhildana Agiriyê de xwedî roleke mezin e. Di sala 1946’an de derbasî Qamişloyê bû û xebatên xwe yên polîtîk domand. Cegerxwîn, di heman salê de bû serokê rêxistina siyasî ya Civata Azadî û Yekitiya Kurd.  Di sala 1948'an de endamê Partiya Komunîst a Sûriyeyê bû û 6 sal piştre ji bo bikeve Parlamentoya Sûriyeyê bû namzetê parlamenteriyê. 


Cegerxwîn, heta sala 1957’an serokatiya saziya Komîteya Aştiyê ya ji bo Cizîrê kir. Piştre ji Partiya Komunist a Sûriyeyê veqetiya û tev li Partiya Demokrat a Kurdistanê ya Sûriyeyê bû. 2 sal piştre dîsa çû Iraqê û li Zanîngeha Bexdayê bû yekemîn mamosteyê ku bi zimanê kurdî dersê dide. Cegerxwîn, di vê pêvajoyê de ji bo zimanê kurdî gelek xebat kir û gelek xwendekar gihand. 


Li Qamişloyê hate binaxkirin


Cegerxwîn, ji ber xebatên xwe yên siyasî, di sala 1963’yan de li Şamê hate girtin. Piştî berdanê jî li gorî rêzê derbasî Herêma Federe ya Kurdistanê, Lubnan û bajarê Swêdê Stockholmê bû. Di 22’yê cotmeha sala 1984’an de jî li Stockholmê wefat kir. Cenazeyê wî li Qamişloyê hate definkirin.  


Ji Mêrdînê heta Stockholmê, ji Bexdayê heta Lubnanê, ji Rojava heta Herêma Federe ya Kurdistanê, Cegerxwîn di vê pêvajoyê de gelek berhemên navdar nivîsand. Di gelemperiya berhemên wî de jî mijara esasî têkoşîna gelê kurd a li dijî burjuvaziyê bû. Cegerxwîn, zextên li gelê kurd tên kirin, înkar, pişaftin, bêkarî, xizanî û çerxa kedxwariyê di helbestên xwe de hûnand. Her wiha Cegerxwîn di helbestên xwe de bal kişand ser azadî, aştî û dijbertiya şer. 


Berhemên Cegerxwîn


Cegerxwîn, "Prîsk û Pêtî (1945)", "Sewra Azadî (1954)", "Kî me Ez? (1973)", "Ronak (1980)", "Zend-Avista (1981)", "Şefeq (1982)", "Hêvî (1983)", "Aşîtî", "Salar û Mîdya" û dîwanên wî yên "Şerefnama Menzûm". author: Harriet Williamson
title: Palantir Targets MPs With ‘Intimidating’ Letters
content:
British MPs who criticised Palantir in parliament received “intimidating” letters from the US spytech firm, Novara Media can reveal. The MPs say it won’t stop them from continuing to hold Palantir to account. 


Former Labour leader Jeremy Corbyn and Labour and Cooperative MP Rachael Maskell both received letters from Palantir’s UK CEO Louis Mosley in June, detailing the MPs’ anti-Palantir contributions in the House of Commons, and offering to meet. 


Corbyn slammed the letters from Mosley as intimidation. “I am in no doubt as to why Palantir is writing these letters to MPs: to intimidate its critics into silence,” he told Novara Media. “Their tactics of intimidation will not work and they will not shut me up. I will never be deterred from speaking out against Palantir, which should have no place in our public services whatsoever.”


Palantir, co-founded by billionaires Alex Karp and Peter Theil, has close ties to the Trump administration. Its

increasing entrenchment in the British state

 via contracts with the NHS, Ministry of Defence and various police forces has sparked

significant national security

and

data privacy concerns

. 


Palantir’s letter to Corbyn listed his comments relating to the firm in the Commons on

1 June

 as part of a debate on the appointment of Peter Mandelson to the post of US ambassador despite his well-documented friendship with the late paedophile Jeffrey Epstein. Mandelson’s now-shuttered lobbying firm Global Counsel counted Palantir among its clients. 


The letter to Maskell listed her statements and questions about Palantir on four separate occasions in parliament, from 10 February to 1 June. Both letters were sent on 3 June. 


Maskell, who represents York Central, told Novara Media the letter from Palantir wouldn’t impact her approach towards the firm. “

Clearly there is a reason as to why Palantir has paid close attention to the scrutiny that MPs have brought to this company which has been handed lucrative contracts by successive governments,” she said. “I have continually expressed my deepest concern about the government engaging with this business, before it was awarded the NHS contract.” 


Independent MP for Leicester South Shockat Adam was also contacted by Palantir. He received an email this month from Palantir’s UK public affairs lead in response to critical tweets about the warfare and AI company’s involvement in the NHS and its now-ended

contract with Leicestershire police

.


Adam told Novara Media: “As public and parliamentary scrutiny grows, MPs who raise concerns are being sent letters from the company’s lobbyists. Palantir says it welcomes scrutiny. Then let it prove it. The public has a right to know how this American company’s software is used across our NHS, our armed forces and our police, on what terms, and who answers for it. 


“Peter Thiel, Alex Karp and Louis Mosley should come to parliament and explain their role in person. Free speech and democratic oversight of public contracts are not optional.”


A Palantir spokesperson said: “There are a great deal of incorrect claims about Palantir circulating online. When politicians – sometimes inadvertently – amplify these falsehoods, they risk misleading the public. The purpose of these letters was to set the record straight. If politicians continue to repeat false claims, we will continue to correct them.”


Clive Lewis, the Labour MP for Norwich South, revealed that he had received a letter from Palantir’s new UK senior VP, Tom Watson,

warning him that the company was surveilling his activities

 relating to Palantir last month. Lewis described this as “very Big Brother” and an “implicit threat”. 


Watson is a former minister and Labour party deputy leader who now sits in the House of Lords, alongside his Palantir job. 


Lewis told Novara Media the Mosley letters in June indicate that Palantir was panicking as the Starmer administration crumbled. “They put all their eggs in one basket with Starmer, and then the writing on the wall was that he wasn’t going to be around much longer.” 


Corbyn has repeatedly

questioned the wisdom

 of using Palantir’s tech in the NHS, given the company’s role in supplying military tech to the IDF during the genocide in Gaza and

surveillance tools to ICE

 as it

conducts brutal a immigration crackdown

 in the US.

highly controversial patient data contract

 with the NHS, which campaigners and medics say has damaged trust in the health …

title: Stadtring Zweibrücken – Pride Month Edition
content:
Edit 2026-10-22: Das Video wurde schon im Sommer hochgeladen, war aber wegen eines Kopierfehlers nicht in tchncs.de auffindbar.


Nur sonntagsfrüh ist der Innenstadtring Zweibrückens per Fahrrad sicher und halbwegs erträglich zu radeln. Das Cockpitvideo zwischen Kirchgang-Aufbrüchen und Brötchenkaufverkehr zeigt die etwa vier Kilometer lange Strecke ungeschnitten – in der Version "vorwärts" gegen den Uhrzeigersinn. Die Rückwärtsstrecke im Uhrzeigersinn (rechtes Video) wurde an verschiedenen Markern geschnitten und die einzelnen Abschnitte in der Geschwindigkeit angepasst.


Eine Stadtringaufnahme vom Januar 2026 auf Youtube war in beiden Richtungen unbearbeitet. Die Strecken stimmen dort nicht so genau überein.


Zur Mitte des Videos gibt es einen Abschnitt, der wegen Einbahnstraßenregelung nicht auf der gleichen Route zurückgelegt werden kann. Hier folgt der UZS der Fruchtmarktsstraße, während gegen den UZS durch die Landauer Straße führt.


Das Projekt ist eine Arbeit im Voranschreiten mit ungewissem Ausgang. Eine Vierjahreszeiten-Collage wäre eine Idee, denn mittlerweile fehlt nur noch die Herbstversion.

author: CNT Galiza
title: La CNT logra el reconocimiento de la improcedencia de un despido disciplinario en la constructora JReformas
content:
Leer en

Castellano

Galego


Castellano

La CNT logra el reconocimiento de la improcedencia de un despido disciplinario en la constructora JReformas


La CNT acaba de sumar una nueva victoria en la lucha contra la arbitrariedad empresarial en el sector de la construcción. En esta ocasión, la intervención del sindicato permitió que se reconociera como improcedente el despido disciplinario de un compañero, tras la actuación de la empresa con absoluto desprecio por las garantías legales que amparan a todo trabajador.


El conflicto surgió tras una discusión entre el trabajador y su jefe. La empresa, lejos de tramitar correctamente el procedimiento disciplinario, dio de baja al trabajador de la Seguridad Social antes de que venciera el plazo para la audiencia previa exigida por ley. Este procedimiento, obligatorio desde la sentencia del Tribunal Supremo del 18 de noviembre de 2024, tiene como objetivo permitir al trabajador defenderse de los hechos que se le imputan antes de que la empresa adopte la decisión definitiva de despido.


Las actuaciones de la empresa JReformas constituyen una grave falta formal. Como establece la jurisprudencia, la falta de una audiencia previa efectiva invalida automáticamente el despido, puesto que la decisión de rescisión se adoptó sin dar al trabajador una verdadera oportunidad de ser escuchado. Además, la baja de la Seguridad Social no constituye una rescisión válida del contrato, sino que puede considerarse un despido de facto.


No se puede despedir a alguien por un hecho consumado. La audiencia previa no es un mero trámite, sino un derecho del trabajador. Que una empresa dé de baja a la Seguridad Social sin la audiencia previa es la prueba más clara de que su intención nunca fue cumplir la ley, sino deshacerse del trabajador cuanto antes.


El resultado de la intervención sindical fue claro: el despido fue declarado injustificado. Para la CNT, esta victoria es un nuevo recordatorio de que los empresarios no pueden eludir los procedimientos legales con impunidad, por mucho que confundan su empresa con un feudo.


La construcción sigue siendo un sector donde la arbitrariedad empresarial campa a sus anchas. Pero cuando los trabajadores nos organizamos, la ley está de nuestro lado.


La CNT recuerda a todos los trabajadores del sector que no están solos. Ante cualquier situación de despido injustificado, represalias o violación de derechos, el sindicato ofrece asesoría y defensa legal.


La construcción no es territorio comanche para los empleadores. Organízate y defiende tus derechos.


En la CNT, si los empleadores atacan, respondemos.


Galego

A CNT logra que se recoñeza a improcedencia dun despedimento disciplinario na empresa de construción JReformas


A CNT vén de sumar unha nova vitoria na loita contra a arbitrariedade patronal no sector da construción. Nesta ocasión, a intervención do sindicato permitiu que se recoñecese a improcedencia do despedimento disciplinario dun compañeiro, despois de que a empresa actuase cun desprezo absoluto polas garantías legais que asisten a calquera traballador.


O conflito xurdiu tras unha discusión entre o traballador e o seu xefe. A empresa, lonxe de tramitar correctamente o procedemento disciplinario, deu de baixa ao traballador na Seguridade Social antes de que rematase o prazo da audiencia previa que a lexislación esixe. Este trámite, obrigatorio desde a sentenza do Tribunal Supremo do 18 de novembro de 2024, ten como finalidade permitir que a persoa traballadora poida defenderse dos feitos que se lle imputan antes de que a empresa adopte a decisión definitiva de despedilo .


A actuación da empresa JReformas constitúe un defecto formal grave. Como recolle a xurisprudencia, a falta dunha audiencia previa efectiva converte automaticamente o despedimento en improcedente, xa que a decisión extintiva foi adoptada sen dar ao traballador a oportunidade real de ser escoitado . A baixa na Seguridade Social, ademais, non equivale a unha extinción válida do contrato, senón que pode ser cualificada como un despedimento de feito .


Non se pode despedir a alguén pola vía dos feitos consumados. A audiencia previa non é un papel para cubrir o expediente, é un dereito do traballador. Que unha empresa dea de baixa a un traballador na Seguridade Social antes de escoitalo é a proba máis clara de que a súa intención nunca foi cumprir coa lei, senón librarse del canto antes.

author: Redazione_web
title: Produzione bellica e sindacati concertativi. Leonardo: ipotesi di piattaforma Contratto Integrativo 2027 – 2029
content:
Non è necessario sottolineare il fatto che le piattaforme sindacali non sono, fra i generi letterari disponibili, le letture più gradevoli; pure sono di un certo interesse perché ci dicono molto sia sulla natura della società in cui viviamo che sull’istituzionalizzazione delle relazioni sociali.


Il caso che proverò a prendere in esame è quello del Gruppo Leonardo attraverso l’ipotesi di piattaforma per il periodo 2027 – 2029 presentata da FIM CISL, FIOM CGIL, UIL.


Partendo dalla Premessa, il documento recita:


“

Scenario e prospettive industriali


Nel corso della vigenza del precedente integrativo i mercati e gli ambiti commerciali a cui fa riferimento Leonardo, hanno visto una forte crescita degli ordinativi, sia nell’ambito civile che della difesa, con scenari e previsioni di una ulteriore crescita almeno nel prossimo triennio. Allo scenario geopolitico che si è determinato si sommano le scelte in ambito europeo con la creazione di nuove alleanze all’interno delle quali Leonardo riveste il ruolo di attore principale.”


In realtà non ci viene svelato alcun segreto, è noto che la spesa militare è in crescita, che viviamo in una situazione di guerra e che ciò, dal punto di vista di un’impresa come Leonardo, è una situazione eccellente. Se si considera poi che il mercato delle armi è gestito in larga parte dagli stati sulla base di contratti di medio lungo periodo e che, di conseguenza, i profitti sono garantiti, il tono ottimista si comprende. Inoltre si comunica che Leonardo ha un ruolo importante in una rete di alleanze rese necessarie dallo sviluppo del mercato delle armi.


Non a caso la Premessa prosegue con queste affermazioni inequivocabili: “Inoltre, nel corso del precedente triennio, l’azienda ha portato a termine diverse acquisizioni che permetteranno di ampliare tecnologie e di posizionare Leonardo a livello dei grandi player globali. In questo quadro gli ultimi dati economici del Gruppo registrano risultati più che positivi, con incremento degli utili e di ordini in crescita in tutte le Divisioni e Aziende del Gruppo.”


FIM, FIOM, UILM si riconoscono il fatto che hanno svolto bene il loro compito e, bontà loro, lodano i lavoratori e le lavoratrici di Leonardo: “Il rinnovo del CCNL Federmeccanica/Assistal, in cui Leonardo è il più grande Gruppo industriale metalmeccanico, ha dato certamente una risposta positiva ed efficace alla perdita del potere di acquisto dei salari delle lavoratrici e dei lavoratori, ma è il momento di dare risposte ulteriori. Se oggi Leonardo è posizionata tra le prime dieci aziende globali del settore Aerospazio, Difesa e Sicurezza è senza dubbio frutto di quante e quanti quotidianamente varcano i siti dell’azienda e attraverso il loro lavoro permettono al management di poter rappresentare orgogliosamente un livello di tecnologie elevatissimo e di poter affrontare le sfide del futuro.”


Proviamo a riassumere:


– L’industria militare dà profitti consistenti;


– Una quota parte di questi profitti permette di dare “certamente un risposta positiva ed efficace alla perdita del potere di acquisto dei salari delle lavoratrici e dei lavoratori”;


– I meriti dei lavoratori vanno riconosciuti e compensati.


FIM, FIOM, UILM propongono di operare col Contratto Integrativo Collettivo Aziendale sul quale “ci sono molte aspettative sulle quali occorre dare risposte su prospettiva industriale, investimenti sulle attività civili “pure” oltre che duali, consolidamento ulteriore di una società unica snella e capace di decidere in tempi rapidi, concludere il percorso di armonizzazione, un percorso di “staffetta generazionale” con accompagnamento alla pensione ecc. In altri tempi la normale attività sindacale in una società “sana”, che garantisce profitti e salari e che vede operare la concertazione.


Ciò che manca nel documento è qualsiasi riferimento al cosa e come si produce, tutto è dato per scontato. Quello di Leonardo è un mondo meraviglioso, c’è solo da di concertarne il governo.


Si tratta di proporre un altro punto di vista che sappia intrecciare efficacemente gli interessi immediati dei lavoratori e la critica della “razionalità” statale e capitalistica. Certo, oggi questi temi si sollevano più in ambito di movimento che sui posti di lavoro, pure dovremmo porci l’obiettivo di portare la contraddizione nel cuore del ciclo produttivo. Hic Rhodus, hic salta.


Cosimo Scarinzi

author: Isabel Seta
title: As ameaças são reais – a resistência também
content:
Nos últimos dias antes do segundo turno da

eleição presidencial

, com o país totalmente mobilizado, um assunto ganhou destaque: o que está em jogo nessas eleições é a Constituição de 1988, que não à toa é chamada de Constituição Cidadã, porque coloca expressamente direitos como educação e saúde gratuitas e universais, igualdade perante a lei, direitos trabalhistas e também direito à natureza preservada, entre outras garantias.


O candidato Flávio Bolsonaro já declarou que, caso eleito, vai mudar a Constituição, o que causa preocupação em muitos setores da sociedade, em especial os mais vulneráveis, como os povos indígenas. O

Bom dia, fim do mundo

 dessa semana fala sobre as principais ameaças aos direitos constitucionais, e também sobre a resistência popular que está se organizando em várias frentes. Ouça agora.

author: CNT Galiza
title: La CNT inicia un conflicto con la empresa IMASA, Ingeniería y Proyectos S.A.: la patronal juega con la salud de la clase trabajadora
content:
Leer en

Castellano

Galego


Castellano

La CNT inicia un conflicto con la empresa IMASA, Ingeniería y Proyectos S.A.


La CNT inicia conflicto con la empresa IMASA, INGENIERÍA Y PROYECTOS S.A., con sede en Oviedo y actividad en todo el estado. La empresa despidió a un trabajador con cinco años de antigüedad tras ser declarado no apto en el último reconocimiento médico, en lugar de adaptar su puesto. El trabajador lleva marcapasos desde antes de su contratación.


La CNT denuncia un nuevo caso de vulneración de los derechos fundamentales en el trabajo. La empresa IMASA, INGENIERÍA Y PROYECTOS S.A., dedicada a la ingeniería y el montaje industrial, despidió a un trabajador con cinco años de experiencia tras ser declarado no apto para el desempeño de sus funciones en el último reconocimiento médico.


El compañero lleva marcapasos desde antes de su contratación. Durante estos cinco años, la empresa lo puso a trabajar en obras e instalaciones sin aparente objeción. Ahora bien, cuando el examen médico indica que el dispositivo médico interactúa con posibles fuentes de campos electromagnéticos presentes en las instalaciones industriales, la empresa decide prescindir de él, en lugar de adaptar el puesto de trabajo o reubicarlo en una función compatible con su condición.


La legislación europea es clara al respecto. El Tribunal de Justicia de la Unión Europea, en una sentencia de 2022 relativa a un trabajador ferroviario belga con marcapasos, estableció que cuando un trabajador queda incapacitado para su puesto de trabajo debido a una discapacidad, la reubicación o adaptación del puesto constituye una medida apropiada como «ajuste razonable». La Directiva 2000/78 exige a los empleadores que adopten medidas adecuadas para permitir que las personas con discapacidad «participen en el empleo», a menos que esto suponga una carga excesiva para el empleador.


La cuestión que plantea la CNT es incómoda: o la empresa mintió y el trabajador está apto, o ha estado poniendo en riesgo su salud y su vida durante cinco años en cada puesto de trabajo que se le asignó. No existe una tercera opción. Si el marcapasos es incompatible con los campos electromagnéticos de las instalaciones industriales, IMASA ha incumplido su obligación de garantizar la seguridad y la salud del trabajador desde el primer día. Si, por el contrario, el trabajador puede desempeñar sus funciones sin riesgo, la falta de aptitud del reconocimiento es una excusa para despedirlo.


En ambos casos, la conclusión es la misma: la empresa actuó ilegalmente y ahora pretende subsanar su propio incumplimiento despidiendo a la persona afectada.


Esta no es la primera vez que IMASA, INGENIERÍA Y PROYECTOS S.A. se ve envuelta en conflictos laborales. En 2020, la empresa presentó un ERE que inicialmente afectó a 110 trabajadores de su plantilla de 857 empleados en 18 centros de trabajo. Finalmente, el expediente se cerró con 58 despidos consensuados con la representación laboral, un episodio que evidencia la actitud de la empresa en materia de reducción de costes.


Ahora, la CNT exige:


La reincorporación inmediata del compañero.


La adaptación de su puesto de trabajo o su reubicación a una función compatible con su estado de salud.


La anulación del despido y el reconocimiento del derecho del trabajador a su empleo.


«No permitiremos que una empresa despida a un trabajador por llevar un marcapasos. Adaptar el puesto es su obligación, no un favor. Y si durante cinco años los han puesto en riesgo, ahora no podrán eludir las consecuencias del despido», denuncia la CNT.


La CNT insta a todos los trabajadores de IMASA y del sector de la ingeniería y el montaje industrial a no aceptar despidos por motivos de salud. La lucha contra la discriminación por discapacidad es una lucha de todos.


IMASA DESPIDE. LA CNT RESPONDE.


Si trabajas en IMASA o en una empresa del sector y sufres represalias, discriminación o despido por motivos de salud, acude a la CNT. No estás solo/a.

author: Cory Massimino
title: Non-Agresi, Pembelaan Diri, dan Hukuman Mati
content:
Oleh: Cory Massimino

. Teks aslinya berjudul “

Non-Aggression, Self-Defense and the Death Penalty

”. Diterjemahkan ke dalam Bahasa Indonesia oleh Taratsa


Salah satu prinsip moral yang dipegang banyak orang adalah bahwa penggunaan kekuatan hanya dapat dibenarkan ketika diperlukan untuk membela diri. Dengan kata lain, kekerasan tidak dapat dibenarkan begitu saja untuk mendapatkan apa yang kita inginkan. Penggunaan kekuatan hanya dianggap sah ketika diperlukan untuk menghadapi ancaman atau menghentikan tindakan agresi.


Pada dasarnya, kita memahami bahwa orang lain bukanlah benda yang bisa diperlakukan sesuka hati. Mereka adalah individu yang memiliki hak dan martabat, sehingga harus dihormati, bukan diperlakukan dengan kekerasan atau penipuan. Kaum libertarian menyebut praduga menentang penggunaan paksaan ini sebagai

prinsip non-agresi

 (

non-aggression principle

). Prinsip ini mengajarkan bahwa seseorang tidak boleh memulai penggunaan kekuatan terhadap orang lain, kecuali sebagai respons yang dapat dibenarkan terhadap agresi.


Kebanyakan orang menerapkan prinsip tersebut dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Namun, ketika berhadapan dengan institusi besar dan persoalan politik yang kompleks, kita sering kesulitan memahami bagaimana prinsip moral yang sama seharusnya diterapkan.


Sebagai contoh, seseorang yang bukan anarkis belum tentu mendukung penggunaan kekerasan terhadap tetangganya. Ia mungkin memiliki niat baik dan menolak kekerasan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Namun, ia bisa saja tidak menyadari bahwa keyakinannya terhadap legitimasi negara bertentangan dengan prinsip moral yang selama ini ia pegang.


Coba pikirkan bagaimana seseorang menjadi libertarian. Perubahan itu tidak selalu berarti bahwa sebelumnya ia menyukai kekerasan atau pemaksaan. Bisa jadi, ia hanya mengalami perubahan pemahaman setelah menyadari konsekuensi politik dari keyakinan moralnya sendiri. Jika seseorang percaya bahwa penggunaan kekuatan pada dasarnya hanya dapat dibenarkan untuk membela diri, ia perlu mempertimbangkan apakah prinsip tersebut juga berlaku terhadap tindakan negara.


Dalam pengertian ini, perubahan menuju libertarianisme bukanlah perubahan dari moralitas yang buruk menjadi moralitas yang baik. Perubahan tersebut lebih merupakan upaya memahami dan menerapkan prinsip moral secara lebih konsisten. Setelah menelaah argumen-argumen baru, seseorang mungkin menyadari bahwa pandangan politiknya selama ini tidak sepenuhnya selaras dengan keyakinan moral yang ia anut.


Lalu, apa yang dapat kita simpulkan dari prinsip bahwa kekuatan hanya boleh digunakan untuk membela diri? Pertanyaan berikutnya adalah: seberapa jauh seseorang boleh menggunakan kekuatan ketika menghadapi agresi?


Meskipun banyak orang sepakat bahwa pembelaan diri dapat membenarkan penggunaan kekuatan, tidak semua orang sepakat mengenai jenis dan besarnya kekuatan yang tepat. Menurut saya, jawabannya dapat ditemukan dengan kembali pada prinsip dasar yang menolak agresi.


Jika penggunaan kekuatan hanya dibenarkan untuk membela diri, maka kekuatan yang digunakan harus benar-benar diperlukan untuk menghentikan agresi. Pembelaan diri tidak memberikan hak tanpa batas untuk menyakiti orang lain. Sebaliknya, tindakan tersebut hanya dapat dibenarkan sejauh diperlukan untuk melindungi diri dari ancaman.


Karena itu, jenis dan besarnya kekuatan yang digunakan harus sebanding dengan agresi yang hendak dihentikan. Jika Anda menginjak jari kaki saya, misalnya, saya boleh mendorong Anda menjauh. Namun, saya tidak berhak menembak Anda hanya karena tindakan tersebut.


Mengapa? Karena menembak Anda merupakan respons yang tidak proporsional. Dorongan sudah cukup untuk menghentikan tindakan yang menyakiti saya. Dengan menembak Anda, saya menggunakan kekuatan yang jauh melampaui apa yang diperlukan. Alih-alih sekadar membela diri, saya justru melakukan agresi baru yang tidak dapat dibenarkan.


Prinsipnya sederhana: pembelaan diri hanya dapat dibenarkan sejauh kekuatan yang digunakan diperlukan dan proporsional untuk menghentikan agresi. Penggunaan kekuatan yang melampaui batas tersebut tidak lagi dapat dianggap sebagai pembelaan diri.


Lantas, apakah ada situasi ketika membunuh seseorang dapat dibenarkan sebagai tindakan pembelaan diri?


Tentu saja, kita dapat membayangkan situasi ketika seseorang menghadapi ancaman mematikan dan tidak memiliki cara lain untuk menyelamatkan diri selain membunuh penyerangnya. Jika seseorang hendak membunuh saya dan satu-satunya cara untuk …

author: Natalia Viana
title: Foragido, líder do garimpo ilegal Rodrigo Cataratas tem empresas e bens de luxo nos EUA
content:
No Brasil, Rodrigo Cataratas gosta de manter um perfil espalhafatoso nas redes sociais. Condenado na primeira instância por liderar o garimpo ilegal na Terra Indígena Yanomami, ele tem mais de 43 mil seguidores no Instagram, onde defende a garimpagem, pede anistia para o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro (preso por tentativa de golpe de Estado) e ataca o governo do PT. 


Mas Rodrigo Martins de Mello – seu nome verdadeiro – é bem mais discreto sobre um aspecto importante da sua vida: seus bens de luxo e suas atividades empresariais nos Estados Unidos, país que frequenta desde os anos 90. Agora sabemos o porquê de tamanha discrição. 


Em dezembro de 2025, o ministro do Supremo Tribunal Federal Alexandre de Moraes decretou a prisão preventiva de Cataratas por ter ajudado na fuga de Alexandre Ramagem, o ex-diretor da Abin do governo Bolsonaro condenado pela trama golpista. Seu pedido de habeas corpus foi negado pela ministra Carmem Lúcia na última terça-feira (19/10), segundo informação do

site Amado Mundo

 confirmada pela

Agência Pública

. “Consta que o mandado de prisão está pendente de cumprimento, pela ausência de localização do paciente até esta data”, escreveu a ministra na decisão. O pedido de prisão preventiva só veio à público nesta semana, já que o processo corre em sigilo.


Pela primeira vez, suas redes estão em silêncio. “Ele sumiu do mapa”, relatou um ex-parceiro de negócios nos EUA localizado pela

Pública

.


Uma investigação conjunta da

Pública

 e do ICIJ (Consórcio Internacional de Jornalistas Investigativos) encontrou rastros do empresário do garimpo ilegal e de sua vida nos Estados Unidos. Ele tem registro de votação como Republicano na Flórida, onde apenas cidadãos norte-americanos podem votar, e manteve empresas ligadas a seu nome e ao de parentes e colegas. Os negócios, todos na Flórida, vão de aluguel de iates à demolição, passando pelo e-commerce.


Uma das empresas ligadas a Cataratas é a X One Charters LLC, fundada em 10 de julho de 2023 e registrada no endereço do apartamento do condomínio Sole Mia, em Miami – onde Cataratas hospedou Ramagem em setembro de 2025, como

revelou a

Pública

. Segundo o documento de fundação da companhia, Cataratas era o dono da empresa. Mas em janeiro de 2026, um mês depois do pedido de prisão preventiva, os registros foram atualizados e ele saiu da sociedade, que passou a ter como diretor Marcos Felix Ribeiro.


Embora no papel a empresa hoje pertença Ribeiro, o WhatsApp de contato do site é um número de Roraima que pertence ao próprio Rodrigo Cataratas.


A empresa foi fundada na época em que Cataratas atuava, segundo o Ministério Público Federal, como um dos líderes de um grupo criminoso responsável por garimpo ilegal e degradação ambiental na

Terra Indígena Yanomami

. Ele foi condenado a 16 anos de prisão e ao pagamento de uma indenização no valor de R$ 31 milhões, mas recorreu e aguarda em liberdade.


A X One Charters oferece aluguel do iate de mesmo nome, segundo

seu site

. O valor pode variar entre R$ 500 mil e R$ 1,2 milhão por algumas horas nas águas de Miami. A embarcação conta com quarto, sala, cozinha e uma área externa de lazer. “Uma embarcação confortável com muitos assentos e acomodações. Cabine espaçosa com AC e banheiro. Sistema de som Premium com Bluetooth para seu entretenimento e tapete aquático para nadar enquanto você aprecia a incrível vista do horizonte da cidade de Miami a partir das águas. Venha conosco para uma experiência incrível”, diz o site, que pode ser lido em inglês, espanhol ou português. Nas fotos, grupos de turistas se deleitam nas águas azuladas da Flórida.


Na mesma alteração nos registros realizada em janeiro de 2026, o endereço da X One Charters mudou. Em vez do Sole Mia, a empresa agora fica sediada em um rancho de 34 acres, o Sunniland Ranch, de propriedade do mesmo Marcos Felix Ribeiro. Procurado pela

Pública

, ele confirmou ter tido transações comerciais com Cataratas em um negócio de mineração na Guiana. Segundo ele, o iate foi dado a ele como pagamento por uma escavadeira sua que ficou no país sulamericano – uma troca estimada em cerca de R$ 500 mil reais (US$ 100 mil).


“Eu peguei esse barco que na realidade é um pesadelo, porque está com problema de vazamento de óleo, um barco desse aqui na água, é 15 mil dólares de multa. Eu tive que tirar esse trambolho da água e no final vai sair mais caro”, diz.


Marcos Felix disse à

Pública

 que conheceu Cataratas quando ele estava com frequência nos EUA, por …

title: A children's manifesto
content:
The speaker reads a manifesto co-written with children at a childcare program run alongside a political festival. The children want adults to stop doomscrolling, stop arguing, stop driving cars and stop factories from emitting fossil fuels. They dream of a world where everyone can do whatever they want, everything is made of squares like Minecraft, and there is lots of sleeping.

title: Leave the kids and go have a nap
content:
A story from the childcare space at a festival. A local grandfather, in no way a radical, came by with his grandchildren and knew nothing about the event. He sat with the children for a while, then asked if he could leave them there so he could have coffee and read the newspaper. He was tired. The answer was yes. Nobody required him to go and be political. He could just have a nap, and the speaker calls that quite special and quite magical for everyone involved.

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 22 octobre
content:
Le 22 octobre, l'éphéméride des luttes reste antifasciste, révolutionnaire et bien décidée à ne pas se laisser couper les jambes par la répression. Aujourd'hui, on prend plusieurs directions différentes mais globalement parallèles.


1882 :

 Attentat au restaurant-théâtre Bellecour, aussi nommé l'Assommoir, à Lyon. «

L'explosion s'est produite vers deux heures du matin. Deux femmes jeunes et élégantes et un homme très bien mis s'y étaient fait servir à souper. Les deux femmes sont parties les premières, l'homme les a suivies peu après. Il venait de quitter le café quand les trois détonations ont retenti , la première assez faible, les deux autres formidables. […] Toute la journée, le parquet et la police ont été sur pied. Aucune arrestation n'a été faite

 ».


Albert Bataille, 25 octobre 1882, reproduit dans

Quand on jugeait les anarchistes

, La Louve éditions, Cahors, 2015, p.48. Le 13 décembre 1883, l'anarchiste Antoine Cyvoct sera condamné à mort par le tribunal pour ces faits, peine qui sera commuée en travaux forcés au bagne de Cayenne avant d'être gracié en 1898.


1892 :

 A Sabadell en Catalogne, parution du journal anarchiste 'Ravachol'.


1894 :

 Lors de la répression de la révolte des bagnards des Îles du Salut meurent un certain nombre d'anarchistes dont Léauthier ou encore l'ancien complice de Ravachol Simon (dit Biscuit).


1895 :

 A Montparnasse, un train un peu trop enthousiaste oublie de s'arrêter, ce qui donnera lieu à l'une des photos les plus spectaculaires de l'histoire des trains en France.


1938 :

 La première photocopie est faite ! C'est le début des brochures.


1948 :

 En Espagne, les partis communiste et socialiste abandonnent la lutte armée contre Franco.


1964 :

 Jean-Paul Sartre refuse le prix Nobel de littérature.


1975 :

 A Avanzano en Italie, les Brigades Rouges enlèvent le chef du personnel d'Ansaldo Nucleare pour cinq heures. Le même jour, les BR tirent sur le chef du personnel de Singer et sur Enrico Boffa, chef de groupe de la DC (Démocratie Chrétienne, le parti au pouvoir).


1977 :

 - A Milan, un cortège antifasciste de 2.000 personnes affronte la police et détruisent plusieurs magasins et lieux de retrouvailles des fascistes. Presque en même temps, un autre cortège prend la direction de l'ambassade d'Equateur pour protester contre le massacre de 100 ouvriers grévistes à Guayaquil : la mercedes du consulat est incendiée, ainsi que le bâtiment d'entrée, qui est attaqué au molotov.


 A Palerme, affrontements entre la police et les manifestants. Plus tard dans la nuit, un attentat revendiqué "Groupe Baader-Meinhof" échoue. Mais le même sigle est utilisé pour revendiquer deux autres explosions dans les transformateurs électriques des cimenteries de l'Isola delle Femmine.


1980 :

 A Venise, les Collectifs Politiques du Veneto, de l'autonomie ouvrière, enlèvent un chef de groupe de l'industrie pétrochimique Montedison de Porto Marghera, la photo duquel apparaîtra ensuite dans les journaux avec un panneau « Je suis un exploiteur de la classe ouvrière ».


1981 :

 A Toulouse, dans le quartier d'Empalot, des explosifs détruisent un pylône à haute tension. L'action sera revendiquée par 'un groupe hostile à la construction de la centrale de Golfech'.


2000 :

 A Vitoria-Gasteiz, au Pays Basque, ETA abat le chef des matons Máximo Casado.


2004 :

 A San Sebastián/Donostia au pays Basque, ETA fait sauter une charge explosive contre une entreprise immobilière.


2007 :

 Au Kurdistan, la guérilla Kurde abat 17 soldats Turcs.


2016 :

 A Saint-Etienne, une manifestation pour le désarmement de la police et la démilitarisation des conflits ravage la permanence du Parti Socialiste et s'en prend à plusieurs banques.


Voir

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 22 octobre.

title: Assemblée Générale des Clameurs et réunion ouverte des causeries
content:
Assemblé Générale des Clameurs 2026


L'Assemblée Générale est un lieu d'échange et de rencontre entre adhérent.e.s de l'association qui a pour finalité de faire le bilan de l'année écoulée, la validation des comptes de l'association et de permettre le renouvellement du conseil d'administration. Cette assemblée générale sera également l'occasion d'entamer une réflexion collective sur l'avenir des Clameurs, son organisation et ses orientations pour l'année à venir.


L'inflation cumulée à la canicule de cet été mettent à mal le modèle économique des Clameurs, on se laisse encore jusqu'à l'été 2027 pour voir si le modèle est viable, mais va falloir qu'on se retrousse les manches d'ici là, et on compte sur vous, nos adhérent.e.s, pour nous aider dans ce nouveau défi pour les clameurs.


Tous.tes les adhérent.e.s présent.e.s auront donc la possibilité d'intégrer s'iels le souhaitent le Conseil d'Administration en tant que membres du collège adhérent.e.s. Être membre du conseil d'administration des Clameurs implique de prendre part aux discussions et aux décisions qui touchent à l'orientation et au fonctionnement général du lieu. Le Conseil d'Administration se réunit au moins trois fois par an pour discuter des questions soulevées par ses membres et inscrites à l'ordre du jour.


Ce rassemblement constitue ainsi une belle occasion pour celles et ceux qui souhaitent s'investir dans un lieu d'échanges politiques et culturels tourné vers l'émancipation sociale, avec la liberté qu'offre une association animée par un esprit solidaire et autogestionnaire.


Ordre du jour de l'Assemblée Générale :


 Rapport moral et bilan de l'année 2026 aux Clameurs

 Bilan financier de l'année 2025 aux Clameurs

 Désignation des nouveaux membres du Conseil d'Administration

 Réorientation de nos fournisseurs

 Évolution du modèle économique des Clameurs


Réunion ouverte des Causeries


Sur la deuxième moitié de la saison 2025-2026 des causeries, l'organisation et l'animation de celles-ci ont reposées majoritairement sur une seule personne. Non seulement c'est fatiguant de gérer tout cela seul, mais c'est aussi pas trop aligné avec le modèle de l'éducation populaire, qui se veut être dans le partage et organisée de manière horizontale.


C'est pourquoi on est en train de reconstituer une nouvelle équipe des causeries aux Clameurs. On cherche aussi des idées de sujets avec des contacts d'auteurs ou de collectifs qui pourraient porter une causerie, tu peux venir alimenter notre boîte à idée.


Également on s'interroge pour savoir comment faire venir plus de monde, l'éducation populaire c'est cool, mais on souhaiterait la partager avec un max de monde pour la rendre plus efficace. Toutes les idées sont les bienvenues pour faire venir du monde et propager les idées anarchistes et autogestionnaire.


Et si tu ne viens pas ou plus aux causeries, tu peux venir en discuter avec nous pour savoir ce qui te motiverait, ou remotiverait, à venir aux causeries, comment on pourrait s'améliorer (format, contenu, horaire, etc…).


Que tu veuilles devenir un.e adhérent.e actif.ve des causeries ou juste donner ton avis, tu es bienvenue à cette réunion ouverte des causeries le lundi 26 octobre 2026 à partir de 19h.


Les causeries des clameurs tirent leur origine des causeries de la fin du 19

e

 au début du 20

e

 siècle. Ces moments de rencontre étaient l'occasion pour les classes ouvrières de s'informer entre elles et de s'organiser de manière horizontale.


L'objectif de ces causeries du 21

e

 siècle est de créer un espace social, où l'on peut échanger en dehors du cadre du travail ou du cadre amical/familial, faire société ensemble. C'est un espace où on peut confronter nos idées et nos arguments et y politiser nos vies, face à un système qui nous pousse de plus en plus à en être passif.


Chacun.e y est légitime pour prendre la parole, ou simplement écouter. Chacun.e y est légitime pour modérer la parole, dans une organisation sans hiérarchie, une organisation anarchiste.

author: Selene Magnolia Gatti, Santi Donaire and Clare Carlile
title: In Pictures: ‘Armageddon’ at Europe’s Swim Spots Linked to Climate Change and Factory Farm Pollution
content:
Across Brittany, tractors can be seen trundling onto beaches to remove truckloads of foul-smelling algae ahead of the tourist rush. 


Situated below steep cliffs and ancient forests, these once pristine beaches have been devastated by algal blooms – the rapid growth of toxic seaweed which kills off fish and plant life. This sea lettuce algae can also release a toxic gas that can cause humans dizziness, chest pain, breathing problems, and even cardiac arrest.


The French peninsula is not alone. Fed by harmful pollution from agriculture, and fuelled by seas warmed by climate change, lurid green blooms are increasingly appearing on beaches and lakes across Europe – prompting hundreds of swimming bans across the continent this summer.

UK/Europe team


Scientists are clear on the cause: for decades, chemicals including nitrogen and phosphorus have leached into waterways from human sewage, as well as fertilisers and excess manure fuelled by the rapid growth of Europe’s factory farms. 


These ‘nutrients’ are vital for plant growth – but in large quantities they destroy the delicate balance of ecosystems, allowing certain plants, including algae, to multiply at the expense of animals and other species.


Green algae on Plage du Yar, Plestin-le-Grèves, in Brittany, France. Agricultural run-off carries the algae down the river Yar and into the sea. Credit: Selene Magnolia Gatti


DeSmog visited some of the worst impacted spots in Europe, speaking to fishers, swimmers, and business owners whose livelihoods and wellbeing depend on healthy waters.


This article was published in partnership with

Euronews

 and Climatica


On the shores of lakes and beaches across France, Spain, Germany and Northern Ireland, we heard accounts of plummeting fish and insect numbers, swimming bans, and beach closures. 


The risks of algal growth have been known for decades, but higher temperatures and longer summers mean these dangerous blooms are growing larger and lasting longer in many of the continent’s most iconic waterways. 


“I remember our beautiful beach before the pollution,” says Brittany resident Jean Hascoet, who leads local campaign group Baie de Douarnenez Environnement. “Now, with thousands of pigs near our town, everything is different.”


Brittany resident and environmental campaigner Jean Hascoet, pictured here in Douarnenez Bay, France, says the surge in intensive farming in the region has devastated local beaches. Credit: Selene Magnolia Gatti


‘Spain’s Sacrificial Zone’


“You’ll never see me swimming in that water again,” Fina says. 


The 84-year-old from Murcia in southeastern Spain lives with her husband Francisco on the beachfront at Los Urrutias, on the west coast of the Mar Menor, Europe’s largest saltwater lagoon. Rotting seaweed piles up on the shore, giving off a foul stench. 


“This used to be paradise. The sea was teeming with seahorses,” Fina says. 


Brittany resident and environmental campaigner Jean Hascoet, pictured here in Douarnenez Bay, France, says the surge in intensive farming in the region has devastated local beaches. Credit: Selene Magnolia Gatti


The last decade has seen a sharp increase in algae growth in the Mar Menor – a hotspot for Spanish and international tourists. Cyanobacteria, also known as blue-green algae, is reliant on nutrients such as nitrogen and phosphorus to grow, and in this region, intensive farming has provided a ready supply. 


Spain is the EU’s largest producer of pork,

accounting

 for a quarter of the bloc’s production. In the Mar Menor catchment area, according to latest

government figures

, 305 pig farms house nearly 700,000 animals – producing vast amounts of manure and slurry, a liquid mixture containing faeces and urine. When it rains, the nutrient-rich mixtures flow from fields into rivers feeding the lagoon.


Algae piled up on one of the Mar Menor’s 22 beaches, Los Urrutias, near Murcia, Spain, due to excess nitrogen from industrial agriculture and livestock farming. Credit: Santi Donaire


“The land can’t accommodate it all,” says Pedro Luengo, a biologist and spokesperson for the campaign group Ecologistas en Acción in Murcia. “We’re a sacrificial zone.”


Tourists now steer clear of the area closest to the farmland – the western region where Fina lives, which was once an idyllic family …

title: İran Devrim Muhafızları Ordusu: Basra Körfezi'nde petrol transferi yapan 4 gemi vuruldu
content:
İran Devrim Muhafızları Ordusu Deniz Kuvvetleri, Basra Körfezi'nin kuzey kesiminde petrol yüklerini gemiden gemiye aktaran 4 geminin eş zamanlı vurulduğunu ve yanmaya devam ettiğini bildirdi.

Devrim Muhafızları tarafından yapılan açıklamada, "izin verilmeyen" güzergahlardan geçtikleri belirtilen 4 geminin petrol transferi sırasında tespit edildiği ve eş zamanlı olarak vurulduğu ifade edildi.

Açıklamada ayrıca, Hürmüz Boğazı'nın batısında dün gece 3 geminin deniz mayınına çarptığı, yangın çıktığı ve gemilerin durdurulduğu belirtildi.

ABD'yi, gemileri mayın döşenmiş geçitten geçmeye teşvik etmekle suçlayan Devrim Muhafızları Ordusu, bu durumun deniz kazalarının artmasına yol açtığını savundu.

Açıklamada, ABD'nin bu tutumunu sürdürmesi halinde karşılık verme kapsamının bölgedeki ABD üslerini de içine alacağı belirtilerek Washington yönetimine uyarıda bulunuldu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Çukurova Belediyesine yönelik soruşturma: Gözaltına alınan 49 kişi adliyeye sevk edildi
content:
Adana — Adana’da Çukurova Belediyesine yönelik yolsuzluk ve usulsüzlük iddialarıyla yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınan, aralarında Çukurova Belediye Başkanı Emrah Kozay ile eski Belediye Başkanı Soner Çetin’in de bulunduğu 49 kişi, jandarmadaki işlemlerinin ardından adliyeye sevk edildi.

Adana Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından Çukurova Belediyesinde gerçekleştirilen ihale ve doğrudan temin işlemlerinde usulsüzlük yapıldığı iddialarına ilişkin yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında 19 Ekim’de operasyon düzenlendi. Jandarma ekiplerince 51 kişiye yönelik gerçekleştirilen operasyonda, aralarında Çukurova Belediye Başkanı Emrah Kozay ve önceki dönem Belediye Başkanı Soner Çetin’in de bulunduğu 44 kişi gözaltına alındı. Sonraki gözaltılarla birlikte sayı 49’a yükseldi.

Soruşturma dosyasında Belediye Başkanı Emrah Kozay’ın "örgüt lideri", eski Belediye Başkanı Soner Çetin ile Kozay’ın teyzesi Sıdıka Şire’nin ise "örgüt yöneticisi" olduğu öne sürüldü. Gözaltına alınanlar arasında bazı belediye başkan yardımcıları ve belediye personelinin de bulunduğu belirtildi.

Soruşturmanın, belediyenin ihale ve doğrudan temin işlemlerinde usulsüzlük yapıldığı, belediyeye bağlı anonim şirket üzerinden gerçekleştirilen bazı alımlarda Kamu İhale Kanunu’ndaki istisna hükmünün usulsüz kullanıldığı ve hakediş ödemeleri karşılığında rüşvet alındığı iddiaları üzerine başlatıldığı aktarıldı.

Dosya kapsamında ayrıca, belediyede çalışmadığı halde maaş aldığı öne sürülen kişilerle ilgili de inceleme yapıldı. Bu kapsamda belediyeye gitmeden maaş aldığı iddia edilen 8 kişi hakkında işlem yapıldı. Gözaltına alınanlar arasında CHP’li Tufanbeyli Belediye Başkanı Ahmet Aktürk’ün kızı E.A.’nın da bulunduğu öğrenildi.

Belediyeden temin edilen 2024, 2025 ve 2026 yıllarına ait ihale ve doğrudan temin evrakının 3 kişilik bilirkişi heyetince incelendiği, hazırlanan rapor ve elde edilen deliller doğrultusunda operasyon kararı alındığı belirtildi.

Jandarmadaki işlemleri tamamlanan 49 kişi, sağlık kontrolünün ardından adliyeye sevk edildi.

author: Unknown
title: Öğrenciler barınamazken Gençlik Bakanlığından vakıf ve derneklere 3,1 milyar TL'lik bütçe
content:
Fahiş kira bedelleri ve artan özel yurt ücretleri karşısında barınma güçlüğü yaşayan öğrencilerin sorunları gündemdeki yerini korurken, Gençlik ve Spor Bakanlığının kâr amacı gütmeyen kuruluşlara ayırdığı kaynak dikkat çekti.

BirGün'den Mustafa Bildircin'in haberine göre, öğrencilerin barınma sorununa yönelik yetersiz adımları nedeniyle eleştirilen Bakanlığın, 2027-2029 döneminde vakıf ve derneklere 10 milyar 472 milyon TL kaynak aktarmayı planladığı ortaya çıktı. Bakanlığın bütçe verilerine göre, "Kâr amacı gütmeyen kuruluşlara yapılan transferler” kalemi için 2027 yılında 3 milyar 86 milyon 977 bin TL ödenek ayrıldı. Bu tutarın 2028’de 3,5 milyar TL’yi, 2029’da ise 3,8 milyar TL’yi aşması öngörülüyor.

Bakanlığın vakıf ve derneklere aktardığı kaynak 2020'de 65,4 milyon TL iken 2024'te 699 milyon TL’ye, 2025’te ise 3 milyar 514 milyon TL’ye yükseldi. 2026’nın ilk altı ayında yapılan transferlerin tutarı da 789 milyon 595 bin TL oldu.

Yüksek kiralar ve özel yurt ücretleri, yetersiz yurt kapasitesi, yurtlardaki kötü koşullar ve barınabilmek için cemaat yurtlarına yönelmek zorunda kalan öğrencilerin yaşadıkları sık sık gündeme geliyor.

author: Unknown
title: Asırlık zeytinlerin rant için kepçe ucunda ölüm yolculuğu
content:
Ege’de yerlerinden sökülen asırlık zeytin ağaçları, e-ticaret siteleri ve ilan platformlarında 5 bin ile 250 bin TL arasında değişen fiyatlarla satışa sunuluyor. Plastik saksılara sıkıştırılan, doğal yaşam alanlarından koparılan bu anıt ağaçların önemli bölümü taşındıkları yerlerde birkaç yıl içinde kuruyarak ölüyor.

Kıyı Ege’nin binlerce yıllık hafızasını taşıyan zeytin ağaçları, artan inşaat baskısı ve gayrimenkul rantı nedeniyle köklerinden koparılıyor. Bodrum, Çeşme, Urla ve Ayvalık gibi popüler tatil ve yaşam merkezlerinde yükselen betonarme yapılar asırlık zeytinlikleri tehdit ederken, yerlerinden sökülen ağaçlar lüks villaların ve butik otellerin bahçelerinde kullanılmak üzere dekoratif ürünlere dönüştürülüyor.

Ortaya çıkan görüntüler, zeytin ağaçlarının doğal ortamlarından koparılarak ticari bir ürüne dönüştürülmesinin ulaştığı boyutu gözler önüne seriyor. Yüzlerce yıllık geçmişe sahip, kalın ve boğumlu gövdeleriyle zamana meydan okuyan ağaçlar, dalları budandıktan sonra büyük siyah plastik saksılara yerleştiriliyor.

Boş arazilerde bir fidanlıktaki süs bitkileri gibi yan yana dizilen asırlık zeytin ağaçları, doğal ekosistemin bir parçası olmaktan çıkarılarak satışa sunuluyor.

Popüler e-ticaret platformları ve ikinci el ilan sitelerinde yapılan incelemelerde, saksılara yerleştirilen zeytin ağaçlarının yaşlarına, gövde kalınlıklarına ve biçimlerine göre fiyatlandırıldığı görülüyor.

Daha genç olgun zeytin ağaçları yaklaşık 5 bin TL’den satışa sunulurken, 100 ila 300 yıllık geçmişe sahip ve “Anıt Zeytin Ağacı” başlığıyla listelenen ağaçların fiyatları 250 bin TL’ye kadar ulaşıyor.

Hafriyat makinelerinin kepçeleriyle taşınan ve büyük saksılara yerleştirilen ağaçlar, vinçler ve hafriyat kamyonları aracılığıyla alıcılara ulaştırılıyor.

Zeytin ağaçlarının sökülmesi ve nakledilmesine ilişkin yasal çerçeveyi düzenleyen 3573 sayılı Zeytinciliğin Islahı ve Yabanilerinin Aşılattırılması Hakkında Kanun’un 20’nci maddesi, Tarım ve Orman Bakanlığının fenni gerekçeye dayanan izni olmaksızın zeytin ağaçlarının sökülmesini ve kesilmesini yasaklıyor.

Ağacın tapulu bir mülk içerisinde ya da imar alanında bulunması bu kuralı ortadan kaldırmıyor. Bakanlık izni olmadan söküm yapan veya ağaçları taşıyan kişilere ağaç başına idari para cezası uygulanıyor.

Ziraat Mühendisi Çağla Güzel Makal, asırlık zeytin ağaçlarının söküm sırasında kök yapılarının büyük zarar gördüğüne dikkat çekti. Zeytinin dayanıklı bir tür olmasına karşın yüzlerce yıldır bulunduğu topraktan ve mikroklimadan koparılmasının ciddi sonuçlar doğurabileceğini belirten Makal, şu değerlendirmede bulundu: “Zeytin onlarca yıldır bulunduğu toprak ve mikro iklimden koparılarak dar plastik saksılara hapsedildiğinde biyolojik şoka giriyor. Taşındıkları yeni peyzaj alanlarında toprağa uyum sağlayamayan anıt ağaçların büyük bir kısmı birkaç yıl içinde tamamen kuruyarak canlılığını kaybediyor.”

author: Kodao Productions
title: SC ruling declaring Marcos budget unconstitutional vindicates Makabayan
content:
The three progressive legislators who voted against the General Appropriation Act (GAA) of both 2004 and 2005 were vindicated by the Supreme Court decision declaring portions of the budgets unconstitutional, the Makabayan Coalition said.


ACT Teachers Party-list’s France Castro, Gabriela Women’s Party’s Arlene Brosas, and Kabataan Party-list’s Raoul Manuel were the only members of the House of Representatives who voted against both national budgets.


“Makabayan lawmakers have long assailed the budget and the pork barrel corruption that has arisen from it. They have long assailed the [bicameral committee] practices of bloating Unprogrammed Appropriations and budgetary infrastructure insertions,” the coalition said.


In the 2024 GAA ratification, the three former representatives registered their “No” votes citing concerns over huge allocations for unprogrammed funds, confidential and intelligence funds (CIFs), and insufficient funding for social services and public utility sectors.


In the 2025 GAA ratification, they again opposed the report, criticizing the sudden increase in unprogrammed appropriations, lack of transparency in bicameral insertions, and reduced budgets for critical sectors like education and health.


In a decision announced this week, the Supreme Court declared portions of the

budgets unconstitutional, faulting Congress for bloating the budget by P449.5-billion in unprogrammed funds in the 2024 GAA and by P17.99-billion in the DPWH Special Road Fund in the 2025 GAA.


The High Court voided the 2024 GAA

as

 it “unlawfully inflated” the total budget beyond President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s recommended ceiling. The Court also struck down the congressional additions to the 2025 budget.


Invalid 2026 budget provisions


The SC likewise invalidated specific special provisions of the 2026 GAA such as the P12.75-billion increase in “special accounts,” the SAGIP

(

Strengthening Assistance for Government Infrastructure and Social Programs) as an “unconstitutional lump-sum appropriation with post-enactment executive discretion.”


The Court affirmed the prohibition on Congress from increasing the total budget recommended by the President that applies to the combined sum of programmed and unprogrammed appropriations.


The decision clarified that the beneficiaries do not need to return funds under the doctrine of operative fact that assumes the projects were implemented in good faith.


The authors, proposers, or implementers of the unconstitutional items can still face civil, criminal, or administrative charges if they acted in bad faith, however.


Proud of ‘lonely stand’


Manuel said he is proud to be one of only three who took the lonely stand against the unconstitutional budgets.


“As ex-Kabataan Partylist rep, I am honored to have witnessed the efforts of fellow former legislators Arlene Brosas and France Castro in scrutinizing the unprogrammed funds,” he said in a social media post.


Manuel said their decision was supported by the research work of Makabayan Coalition’s congressional staff who flagged so-called unprogrammed funds when they were still being proposed in Congress.


“Even after the budget bills were signed into law by the corrupt president Marcos Jr., progressive groups kept a close watch on the unprogrammed appropriations. This led to the discovery that Marcos Jr. authorized the use of these funds for flood control projects—bypassing Congress and the standard budgetary process,” Manuel pointed out.


“Although we are outnumbered within the House of Representatives—a hotbed for traditional politicians and political dynasties—our advocacies are bearing fruit, thanks to the strength of the Filipino people’s collective struggle outside the halls of Congress,” he added. #

(Raymund B. Villanueva)

SC ruling declaring Marcos budget unconstitutional vindicates Makabayan
